description: Baseline permissions for a DevKit window. The sidecar is spawned from Rust, so no shell permissions are exposed to the frontend; the updater and a restart are, because installing a new version is asked for from the UI, the window permissions are what lets the inspector be opened in a window of its own, and setting the title is how a tab comes to be named after the page it is showing rather than after the app. One entry per shape of app-window label: `main` is the one the config opens, `s1`, `s2`, … are the comparisons opened after it.
